rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for pondering or having a thought in mind.

example.english: I think about whether to go see a movie tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我諗緊聽日去唔去睇戲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 gan2 ting1 jat6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this for expressing an opinion or judging that someone or something is a certain way.

example.english: I think this restaurant is pretty good.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when you are guessing or making an uncertain estimate.

example.english: I think he is still at home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 zung6 hai2 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when explicitly regarding A as or treating A as B.

example.english: We think of this place as our own home.
example.traditional: 我哋當呢度係自己屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dong3 ni1 dou6 hai6 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei2
